claims: Academy Awards are commonly known as the Oscars.
Academy Awards are annual awards for artistic and technical merit in the film industry.
Academy Awards are presented by the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences (AMPAS).
Academy Awards were established in 1927.
Academy Awards were first held in 1929.
The 97th Academy Awards took place in 2025.
Anora won Best Picture at the 97th Academy Awards.
Sean Baker won Best Director at the 97th Academy Awards.
Sean Baker won Best Original Screenplay at the 97th Academy Awards.
Adrien Brody won Best Actor for The Brutalist at the 97th Academy Awards.
Mikey Madison won Best Actress for Anora at the 97th Academy Awards.
Kieran Culkin won Best Supporting Actor for A Real Pain at the 97th Academy Awards.
Zoe Saldaña won Best Supporting Actress for Emilia Pérez at the 97th Academy Awards.
Oppenheimer won Best Picture at the 96th Academy Awards.
Everything Everywhere All At Once won Best Picture at the 95th Academy Awards.
Nomadland won Best Picture at the 93rd Academy Awards.
Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences is located in Beverly Hills, California.
Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences has over 11,000 members.
Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences operates the Academy Museum of Motion Pictures.
Oscara is a 100% owned iron oxide copper gold (IOCG) project of Aldebaran Resources in Argentina's Salta Province.
Oscara Studio is software used for creating oscilloscope art.
Oscar is the son of Oisín and Niamh in the Fenian Cycle of Irish Mythology.
OSCAR refers to Ocean Surface Current Analysis – Real time.
OSCAR refers to the OSCAR Electronic Medical Record system
